A '''planet''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Riggs Ashar]], who worked for the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Unidentified planetary militia|militia]] by guarding the [[Hangar/Legends|landing area]] at a [[Unidentified spaceport (Riggs Ashar)|spaceport]]. Near the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], there was a [[Unidentified spacer bar|bar]] that Ashar frequented.
